output.reason: [ev-5e95ef039bdc] and [ev-fd8c79157fd7] say Argo CD now supports Kustomize's `--include-templates` option for labels. The `--include-templates` flag itself belongs to Kustomize, so it is not an Argo CD flag with component "kustomize". [ev-b5b664c0827a] shows the PR changed the Application/ApplicationSet CRDs, swagger.json and the docs for `argocd app create`, `argocd app set` and `argocd app add-source`, so what Argo CD added is probably a new CRD field and/or argocd CLI flag. The evidence never names that field path or flag, so neither the proposed subject nor a corrected one can be confirmed; the CRD diff or the CLI docs from the PR are needed.
